categories.name: Kids Birthday
categories.intro: Themed setups built around what your child actually loves — arch, backdrop, cutouts and a cake table that photographs well.

categories.name: Adult Birthday
categories.intro: Grown-up palettes and cleaner lines — for milestone birthdays, surprise parties and terrace celebrations.

categories.name: Baby Shower
categories.intro: Soft-palette backdrops, balloon clouds and dessert-table styling for the photos everyone will want.

categories.name: Welcome Baby Home
categories.intro: For the day the newest member comes home — welcome banners, gentle balloon work and nursery styling.

categories.name: Naming Ceremony
categories.intro: Traditional touches with a modern finish — cradle decoration, name boards and warm floral work.

categories.name: Anniversary & Romantic
categories.intro: Candlelight, florals and quiet detail — for anniversaries, proposals and first-night setups.

categories.name: Haldi & Engagement
categories.intro: Bright daytime haldi setups and ring-ceremony stages designed to photograph well from every angle.

categories.name: Housewarming
categories.intro: Entrance rangoli, torans and pooja-area styling to welcome everyone into the new home.

categories.name: Corporate & Shop Opening
categories.intro: Branded stages, launch setups and entrance styling for office celebrations and new store openings.

categories.name: Add-ons
categories.intro: Small extras that can be added to any setup, or booked on their own.
